checks.evidence: deploy/native_launcher.py:91-105 keeps a separate poll registration after the bounded selector reader is removed. POLLHUP and POLLRDHUP establish the stop deadline independently of draining pending bytes. The full-buffer path does not call os.read with zero capacity.
checks.assessment: No new actionable issue found by source inspection. Linux kernel behavior was not executed independently in this review.

checks.evidence: src/runtime/native.ts:147-184 calls fail before stdin.destroy, classifies submitted writes as unknown and queued writes as not_sent, caches closePromise, and requires launcher close with exit code zero within the deadline.
checks.assessment: No new actionable issue found. destroy removes the dependency on flushing the blocked write callback; it does not change already-submitted operations into not_sent.

checks.evidence: src/runtime/native-launch.ts uses a fixed sudo target and launcher. deploy/units.py:sudo_rule disables use_pty. The launcher path in NativeRpc.stop does not rely on the control UID being able to signal the native UID. deploy/native_launcher.py validates the fixed non-root native identity and removes inherited descriptors.
checks.assessment: Static path is consistent with the UID separation. The inspected native.test.ts case substitutes nativeCommand and therefore does not itself establish actual sudo or different-UID behavior. No such runtime claim is made here.

checks.evidence: deploy/native_launcher.py:48-71 checks for no direct children after subreaping and a reaped main child; supervise requires cleanup success before returning zero for a requested streaming stop. src/runtime/native.ts also waits for the child close event and rejects nonzero or unconfirmed exits.
checks.assessment: No new actionable issue found within the current supervised-process model. Source inspection does not replace live process-tree or cgroup evidence.

checks.evidence: The bridge bounds pending input to 8 MiB and re-enables reads after draining. tests/deploy/test_deployment.py keeps the writer open while a reader pauses for three seconds and verifies a roughly 12 MiB payload digest. Shutdown tests cover pipe saturation, socket half-close saturation, escaped-session descendants, crashes, and false cleanup acknowledgement. NativeRpc tests check a blocked 10 MiB write, queued not_sent classification, unknown sent work, idempotent close, and retained-budget release.
checks.assessment: The inspected cases exercise the intended distinction between saturation and EOF. No new actionable regression defect found.

limitations: Targeted independent source review only; not a complete repository audit and not a clean-round increment.
No Linux commands, full tests, external services, credentials, old implementations, Git history, or prior audit/fix reports were intentionally accessed.
No tests were duplicated because the parent was executing the three selected test files in isolation on the authorized Linux host.
The parent reported Linux 72/72 passing with zero skips and confirmed test cgroup exit. This is parent-provided evidence, not an independently rerun result of this reviewer.
No claims are made about uninspected integration paths or actual different-UID sudo execution.
